definitions.explanation: The concept of being reborn into a new life or body after death, rooted in Buddhist and Hindu thought. Also widely used in modern fiction, especially the isekai (another-world) genre.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{転生|てんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: In Buddhism, one believes in reincarnation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異世界|いせかい}→異世界：18438_isekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転生|てんせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流行|はや}っている→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧。
examples.english: Stories about reincarnating in another world are popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦もし→もし：01284_moshi⟧⟦{生|う}まれ{変|か}わる→生まれ変わる：13522_umarekawaru⟧なら、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転生|てんせい}⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He joked that if he were to be reborn, he'd like to be reincarnated as a cat.

notes:
Compound of {転|てん} (to turn, to change) + {生|せい} (life, birth). Used as a suru-verb: {転生|てんせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be reincarnated).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{異世界|いせかい}→異世界：18438_isekai⟧{転生|てんせい} (reincarnation in another world — isekai genre)
- {転生|てんせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be reincarnated)
- {転生|てんせい}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (the life/world one is reincarnated into)

CULTURAL NOTE:
While originally a Buddhist concept, {転生|てんせい} has become hugely popular in modern Japanese pop culture through the "isekai" (another-world) genre of light novels, manga, and anime, where protagonists die and are reborn in fantasy worlds. The related term ⟦{輪廻|りんね}→輪廻：14486_rinne⟧ (samsara) is more formal and philosophical.
